news_api.models module¶

Data models for the news ecosystem application layer.

Handles entity definitions, role-based mutual exclusivity validations, and automatic permission group synchronization through database lifecycle signals.

class news_api.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Represents an individual text news report created by assigned writers.

Articles operate under a strictly enforced exclusive single-ownership pattern. They must originate from either an independent journalist or a corporate publisher, but cannot belong to both sources simultaneously.

title¶

The editorial headline text of the news post.

Type:

CharField

content¶

The primary body copy text of the coverage item.

Type:

TextField

author¶

Relationship link pointing to the writing journalist.

Type:

ForeignKey

publisher¶

Corporate owner tenancy connection linking this post to an agency.

Type:

ForeignKey

created_at¶

Non-editable registration timestamp marking draft generation.

Type:

DateTimeField

approved¶

Editorial flag tracking publication eligibility status.

Type:

BooleanField

save(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Commits profile properties while enforcing data isolation constraints between roles.

Clears reader-specific tracking vectors if the profile becomes a journalist, and disconnects active author relationships if the user transitions to a reader.

  • *args – Variable length argument list forwarded to the parent model class.

  • **kwargs – Arbitrary keyword arguments forwarded to the parent model class.

news_api.models.sync_user_permission_groups(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]¶

Automates profile role syncing across Django Authorization Groups upon user profile saves.

  • created (bool) – Boolean flag highlighting fresh database row additions.

Manages workspace staff rosters for a logged-in Editor’s Publisher organization.

Processes incoming transactional instructions to add new personnel (Editors or Journalists) to the publication network, offboard existing active staff entries smoothly, and extract available unassigned pools.

request (HttpRequest) – Core framework context capturing HTTP environment values, session state lookups, and multi-attribute dictionary transaction properties.
